items.query:
MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting), (t)-[:RELATED_TO]->(w:WorkItem)
WHERE m.meetingNumber = 'RAN1#120' AND w.workItemCode = 'NR_eMIMO-Core'
RETURN DISTINCT t.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber

MATCH (d)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting), (d)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company)
WHERE (d:Tdoc OR d:CR OR d:LS OR d:SessionNotes OR d:Summary)
  AND m.workingGroup = 'RAN1'
  AND (m.meetingNumber = 'RAN1#120' OR m.canonicalMeetingNumber = 'RAN1#120')
  AND c.companyName = 'Huawei'
  AND d.tdocNumber IS NOT NULL
RETURN DISTINCT d.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber

MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(a:AgendaItem), (t)-[:MODERATED_BY]->(c:Company), (t)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE t.summaryType = 'FL' AND c.companyName = 'Huawei' AND m.workingGroup = 'RAN1' RETURN DISTINCT a.agendaNumber AS agendaNumber

MATCH (a:Section)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(b:Section), (b)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(a), (a)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sa:Spec), (b)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sb:Spec)
WHERE a.sectionId < b.sectionId
RETURN DISTINCT a.sectionId AS sectionIdA, b.sectionId AS sectionIdB, sa.specNumber + '-' + a.sectionNumber AS sectionA, sb.specNumber + '-' + b.sectionNumber AS sectionB
ORDER BY sectionIdA, sectionIdB, sectionA, sectionB
LIMIT 20

MATCH (section:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(spec:Spec)
WHERE toLower(section.sectionTitle) CONTAINS 'antenna'
RETURN DISTINCT spec.specNumber AS specNumber

MATCH (cr:CR)
OPTIONAL MATCH (cr)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(spec:Spec)
WITH cr, count(DISTINCT spec) AS affectedSpecCount
ORDER BY affectedSpecCount DESC, cr.crNumber ASC
LIMIT 10
CALL {
  WITH cr
  OPTIONAL MATCH (cr)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(spec:Spec)
  WITH DISTINCT spec.specNumber AS specNumber
  ORDER BY specNumber ASC
  RETURN collect(specNumber) AS affectedSpecs
}
RETURN cr.crNumber AS crNumber, affectedSpecCount, affectedSpecs
ORDER BY affectedSpecCount DESC, crNumber ASC

MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R2-2508373'}), (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting)
RETURN DISTINCT r.resolutionId AS resolutionId, m.meetingNumber AS meetingNumber

MATCH (w:WorkItem)<-[:RELATED_TO]-(t:Tdoc)<-[:REFERENCES]-(r:Resolution), (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company)
WHERE w.workItemCode IS NOT NULL AND c.companyName IS NOT NULL
WITH DISTINCT w
ORDER BY w.workItemCode ASC
LIMIT 5
CALL {
  WITH w
  MATCH (w)<-[:RELATED_TO]-(t:Tdoc)<-[:REFERENCES]-(r:Resolution), (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company)
  WHERE c.companyName IS NOT NULL
  WITH c.companyName AS company, count(DISTINCT r) AS count
  ORDER BY count DESC, company ASC
  LIMIT 5
  RETURN collect({company: company, count: count}) AS topCompanies
}
RETURN w.workItemCode AS workItemCode, topCompanies AS topCompanies
ORDER BY workItemCode ASC

MATCH (cr:CR)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(:Company {companyName: 'Huawei'})
MATCH (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(spec:Spec)
WHERE spec.specNumber IS NOT NULL
RETURN spec.specNumber AS specNumber, count(DISTINCT cr) AS crs

MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(hub:Spec)
WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL
WITH hub, count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCnt
CALL {
  WITH hub
  MATCH (releaseSpec:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub)
  WHERE releaseSpec.specRelease =~ '^Rel-[0-9]+$'
  WITH releaseSpec
  ORDER BY toInteger(substring(releaseSpec.specRelease, 4)) DESC, releaseSpec.id ASC
  LIMIT 1
  RETURN releaseSpec
}
MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(releaseSpec)
WITH hub, crCnt, count(DISTINCT sec) AS secCnt
WHERE secCnt > 0
RETURN DISTINCT hub.specNumber AS specNumber, crCnt AS crCnt, secCnt AS secCnt, round(100.0 * crCnt / secCnt) / 100.0 AS density

MATCH (n)
UNWIND labels(n) AS class
WITH n, class
WHERE class IN ['RRCParameter', 'CapabilityItem', 'Procedure', 'PerformanceRequirement', 'ConformanceTest']
RETURN class AS class, coalesce(n.granularity, '<unset>') AS granularity, count(DISTINCT n) AS count

MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.825'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(impact:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(spec:Spec)
RETURN DISTINCT spec.specNumber AS specNumber, impact.impactType AS impactType

MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(impact:TRImpact)
WHERE impact.impactType = 'ExtendSection'
RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber AS trNumber

MATCH (d)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN3#130'}) WHERE (d:Tdoc OR d:CR OR d:LS) AND d.status = 'agreed' AND d.tdocNumber IS NOT NULL RETURN DISTINCT d.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber

MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company), (t)-[:RELATED_TO]->(w:WorkItem), (t)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting)
WHERE c.companyName = 'Samsung'
  AND w.workItemCode = 'NR_newRAT-Core'
  AND m.workingGroup = 'RAN3'
RETURN DISTINCT m.meetingNumber AS meetingNumber, t.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber

MATCH (spec:Spec {specNumber: '38.413'})
WHERE spec.specRelease =~ 'Rel-[0-9]+'
WITH spec, toInteger(substring(spec.specRelease, 4)) AS releaseNumber
ORDER BY releaseNumber DESC, spec.id ASC
LIMIT 1
MATCH (spec)-[:HAS_SECTION]->(section:Section {sectionNumber: '9.3.1'})
WITH DISTINCT section
ORDER BY section.sectionId ASC
LIMIT 1
MATCH (section)-[:HAS_SUB_SECTION]->(child:Section)
RETURN DISTINCT child.sectionId AS sectionId, child.sectionNumber AS sectionNumber, child.sectionTitle AS sectionTitle

MATCH (cr:CR)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-18'}), (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(spec:Spec)
WHERE spec.specNumber IS NOT NULL
RETURN spec.specNumber AS specNumber, count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCnt
ORDER BY crCnt DESC, specNumber ASC
LIMIT 5

MATCH (f:TSFigure)-[:FIGURE_IN_SECTION]->(:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(s:Spec)
RETURN s.specNumber AS specNumber, count(DISTINCT f) AS figCnt

MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(section:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(spec:Spec)
WHERE section.sectionNumber = '9.4.5' AND spec.specNumber = '38.473'
RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, cr.reasonForChange AS reason

MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release), (tr)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(impact:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(spec:Spec)
WHERE r.releaseName = 'Rel-17'
RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber AS trNumber, spec.specNumber AS specNumber, impact.impactType AS impactType

MATCH (n)
UNWIND labels(n) AS label
RETURN label AS label, count(DISTINCT n) AS cnt

MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting), (r)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(release:Release)
WHERE (r:Resolution OR r:Agreement OR r:Conclusion OR r:WorkingAssumption)
  AND m.workingGroup = 'RAN4'
  AND release.releaseName = 'Rel-15'
  AND r.resolutionId IS NOT NULL
RETURN DISTINCT r.resolutionId AS resolutionId

MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(s:Spec)
WHERE s.specNumber = '38.133' AND r.resolutionId IS NOT NULL
RETURN DISTINCT r.resolutionId AS resolutionId

MATCH (section:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(spec:Spec)
WHERE spec.specNumber = '38.104' AND section.level = 2
RETURN DISTINCT section.sectionId AS sectionId, section.sectionNumber AS sectionNumber, section.sectionTitle AS sectionTitle

MATCH (section:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(source:Spec), (section)-[reference:REFERENCES_SPEC]->(target:Spec)
WHERE source.specNumber <> target.specNumber
RETURN source.specNumber AS fromSpec, target.specNumber AS toSpec, count(reference) AS refCount
ORDER BY refCount DESC, fromSpec ASC, toSpec ASC
LIMIT 10

MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(impact:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(spec:Spec)
WHERE impact.impactType = 'ExtendSection'
RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber AS trNumber, spec.specNumber AS specNumber

MATCH (:TechnicalReport)-[r:REFERENCES_TR]->(tr:TechnicalReport)
WITH tr, count(r) AS refCount
RETURN tr.trNumber AS trNumber, refCount AS refCount
ORDER BY refCount DESC, trNumber ASC
LIMIT 5

MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem), (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company)
RETURN wi.id AS wi_id, c.companyName AS company, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt

MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting), (r)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company)
WHERE m.workingGroup = 'RAN5' AND c.companyName = 'Samsung'
WITH m, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt
RETURN m.meetingNumber AS meeting, cnt AS cnt
ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt ASC, meeting ASC

MATCH (t:TSTable)-[:TABLE_IN_SECTION|CONTAINS_TABLE]-(s)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC|HAS_SECTION]-(spec:Spec)
WHERE t.tableNumber STARTS WITH '6.2.'
  AND (s:Section OR s:ConformanceTest)
RETURN DISTINCT spec.specNumber AS specNumber, s.sectionId AS sectionId, t.tableNumber AS tableNumber

MATCH (spec:Spec), (section)
WHERE spec.specNumber = '38.521-2'
  AND (section:Section OR section:ConformanceTest)
  AND section.level = 2
  AND (EXISTS { MATCH (spec)-[:HAS_SECTION]->(section) }
       OR EXISTS { MATCH (section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(spec) })
RETURN DISTINCT section.sectionId AS sectionId,
                section.sectionNumber AS sectionNumber,
                section.sectionTitle AS sectionTitle

MATCH (spec:Spec)
WHERE spec.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.5'
OPTIONAL MATCH (:Section)-[rel:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(spec)
RETURN spec.specNumber AS specNumber, count(rel) AS sectionCount
ORDER BY sectionCount DESC, specNumber ASC
LIMIT 5

MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(impact:TRImpact)
WHERE impact.impactType = 'NoChange' AND tr.trNumber IS NOT NULL
RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber AS trNumber

MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT|IMPACT_OF_TR]-(impact:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SPEC|SPEC_IMPACTED_BY]-(spec:Spec {specNumber: '38.533'}) RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber AS trNumber, impact.impactType AS impactType
